//: Copy to .sentinel-shield/accepted-risks.json. Only APPROVED, unexpired, owner-bound records suppress, and only for suppressible gates (unsafe_docker, medium_vulnerabilities). secrets/expired_exceptions/missing_release_evidence are NEVER suppressed. Suppression is reported and the raw count is preserved (not zeroed). A Markdown draft alone does NOT suppress anything.
//scope: Records are FINDING-SCOPED by default. unsafe_docker matches on rule_id + files (reports/raw/hadolint.json, docker-base-digest.json). medium_vulnerabilities matches on components / fingerprints / rule ids / files against the normalized findings from scripts/normalize-findings.sh (grype, osv-scanner, trivy-fs, composer-audit, npm-audit, dependency-check). EVERY dimension a record declares must match, so adding one only narrows the exception. Broad gate-wide suppression requires explicit "scope":"gate", is discouraged, and also covers findings that appear LATER. A record with neither scope nor any matching field is ambiguous and does NOT suppress.
